spans.t: Prying eyes had become a nuisance
along the Old Road, and so I undertook
to receive my most curious deliveries
by way of marine shipments. A
sheltered jetty was accessible by a
narrow stone stair off the back of
the manor, and a discreet system
of pulleys could hoist even the
heaviest prizes up the rock face
from a securely tied dinghy below.
